body: TermAl install builds on Central use the shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR target/install-target. Cargo judges freshness of path sources by mtime. A gate worktree checked out BEFORE the previous install build therefore looks "Fresh", and cargo silently reproduces the previous binary. This happened on 2026-11-07: w-24a7 finished in 0.99s and gave the same sha as M1, 752ecad6. ALWAYS run `cargo clean --release -p termal --target-dir <install-target>` from the gate worktree before the install build. Then confirm the log has exactly one "Compiling termal v0.1.0 (<gate worktree>)" and that the sha differs from the installed one before copying.
